title: Background color
description: Change the background color of the page.
explanation: Change the background color of the page.
usage: Use this when you need to change the background color of the page.
mistakes: Choose enough contrast between background and foreground.

title: Text color
description: Set the foreground color of paragraphs.
explanation: Set the foreground color of paragraphs.
usage: Use this when you need to set the foreground color of paragraphs.
mistakes: color changes text, while background-color changes the surface.

title: Typography
description: Choose readable fonts and line spacing.
explanation: Choose readable fonts and line spacing.
usage: Use this when you need to choose readable fonts and line spacing.
mistakes: Keep fallback fonts in case the preferred font is unavailable.

title: Font size
description: Scale a heading smoothly across screen sizes.
explanation: Scale a heading smoothly across screen sizes.
usage: Use this when you need to scale a heading smoothly across screen sizes.
mistakes: clamp needs a minimum, preferred value, and maximum in that order.

title: Spacing
description: Add internal and external spacing to a card.
explanation: Add internal and external spacing to a card.
usage: Use this when you need to add internal and external spacing to a card.
mistakes: Padding is inside the border; margin is outside.

title: Border
description: Give a card an outline and rounded corners.
explanation: Give a card an outline and rounded corners.
usage: Use this when you need to give a card an outline and rounded corners.
mistakes: Border needs a style such as solid to become visible.

title: Flex row
description: Align elements horizontally with equal gaps.
explanation: Align elements horizontally with equal gaps.
usage: Use this when you need to align elements horizontally with equal gaps.
output: Direct child elements appear in a horizontal row, separated by 1rem.
mistakes: Flex applies to direct children, not all descendants.

title: Center content
description: Center content on both axes.
explanation: Center content on both axes.
usage: Use this when you need to center content on both axes.
mistakes: The container needs a meaningful height for vertical centering.

title: Grid columns
description: Arrange cards in three equal columns.
explanation: Arrange cards in three equal columns.
usage: Use this when you need to arrange cards in three equal columns.
output: Three equal-width columns with a 1rem gap.
mistakes: Three fixed columns may overflow on narrow screens; add a breakpoint.

title: Maximum width
description: Keep content centered with readable widths.
explanation: Keep content centered with readable widths.
usage: Use this when you need to keep content centered with readable widths.
mistakes: Use min() with valid compatible lengths and account for page gutters.

title: Hover state
description: Change a button appearance on hover.
explanation: Change a button appearance on hover.
usage: Use this when you need to change a button appearance on hover.
mistakes: Hover is not available on every touch device; keep keyboard focus visible.

title: Transition
description: Animate a change in button properties.
explanation: Animate a change in button properties.
usage: Use this when you need to animate a change in button properties.
mistakes: Animate specific properties instead of transition: all.

title: Box shadow
description: Lift a surface using a soft shadow.
explanation: Lift a surface using a soft shadow.
usage: Use this when you need to lift a surface using a soft shadow.
mistakes: Large blur radii can hurt scrolling performance.

title: Gradient
description: Blend two colors across a background.
explanation: Blend two colors across a background.
usage: Use this when you need to blend two colors across a background.
mistakes: The gradient is an image value for background, not color.

title: Sticky header
description: Keep a header visible while scrolling.
explanation: Keep a header visible while scrolling.
usage: Use this when you need to keep a header visible while scrolling.
mistakes: A scrolling ancestor with overflow can change sticky behavior.

title: Absolute badge
code:
.card { position: relative; }
.badge { position: absolute; top: 1rem; right: 1rem; }
description: Position a badge relative to its card.
explanation: Position a badge relative to its card.
usage: Use this when you need to position a badge relative to its card.
mistakes: Absolute positioning uses the nearest positioned ancestor.

title: Responsive breakpoint
description: Switch a grid to one column on small screens.
explanation: Switch a grid to one column on small screens.
usage: Use this when you need to switch a grid to one column on small screens.
output: At viewport widths of 640px or less, .grid has one column.
mistakes: Media queries test the viewport, not a component width.

title: Auto-fit grid
code: .grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 240px), 1fr)); gap: 1rem; }
description: Fit as many card columns as the available width allows.
explanation: Fit as many card columns as the available width allows.
usage: Use this when you need to fit as many card columns as the available width allows.
mistakes: The nested min() lets a card shrink below 240px on very small screens.

title: Custom properties
description: Share a reusable color across selectors.
explanation: Share a reusable color across selectors.
usage: Use this when you need to share a reusable color across selectors.
mistakes: Custom property names begin with two hyphens and are case sensitive.

title: Focus ring
description: Make keyboard focus clearly visible.
explanation: Make keyboard focus clearly visible.
usage: Use this when you need to make keyboard focus clearly visible.
mistakes: Do not remove the focus outline without an equally visible replacement.

title: Image crop
description: Crop images to a consistent aspect ratio.
explanation: Crop images to a consistent aspect ratio.
usage: Use this when you need to crop images to a consistent aspect ratio.
mistakes: object-fit needs a constrained image box to show cropping.

title: Reset sizing
description: Include borders and padding in element widths.
explanation: Include borders and padding in element widths.
usage: Use this when you need to include borders and padding in element widths.
mistakes: Apply border-box to pseudo-elements as well as elements.

title: Text truncation
code: .truncate { overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
description: Truncate a single line of overflowing text.
explanation: Truncate a single line of overflowing text.
usage: Use this when you need to truncate a single line of overflowing text.
mistakes: Ellipsis needs overflow hidden and a constrained available width.

title: Keyframe animation
code:
@keyframes fade-in { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }
.card { animation: fade-in 300ms ease; }
description: Fade a card into view.
explanation: Fade a card into view.
usage: Use this when you need to fade a card into view.
mistakes: Define the keyframe name before referencing it and honor reduced motion.

title: Reduced motion
description: Respect a visitor’s reduced motion preference.
explanation: Respect a visitor’s reduced motion preference.
usage: Use this when you need to respect a visitor’s reduced motion preference.
mistakes: Keep essential state changes visible even when animation is disabled.

title: Dark theme
description: Adapt the page to the system dark theme.
explanation: Adapt the page to the system dark theme.
usage: Use this when you need to adapt the page to the system dark theme.
mistakes: System color scheme is a preference, not a stored app setting.

title: Complete card layout
description: Style a readable responsive profile card.
explanation: Style a readable responsive profile card.
usage: Use this when you need to style a readable responsive profile card.
output: A centered card with light text on a dark background.
mistakes: These rules expect an element with class="card" in the linked HTML.
